description.value: A full-service private campground at Mile 300 on the Alaska Highway in Fort Nelson, with an on-site restaurant, coin showers, laundry, and propane — a practical resupply stop for Alaska Highway cyclists, though the setting is purely highway-town utilitarian.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website was successfully fetched and provides detailed amenity information for this Fort Nelson RV park and campground. The site explicitly confirms tent sites, 24-hour coin-operated laundry and shower facilities, an on-site family restaurant, propane sales, and reservations by phone or email. A notable address discrepancy exists: OSM records '5651 Alaska Highway' while the website consistently lists '5751 Alaska Highway, Fort Nelson, BC' across every page.
concerns: Address discrepancy: OSM lists '5651 Alaska Highway' but the website consistently shows '5751 Alaska Highway, Fort Nelson, BC' across all pages — the OSM house number may be incorrect.
OSM name is 'Triple G Hideaway RV' but the business operates as 'Triple G Hideaway RV Park & Campground' (or 'Triple "G" Hideaway RV Park & Campground') per the website.
OSM record has no phone number; website lists 250-774-2340 (reservations/office) and 250-775-6400 (restaurant) — OSM should be updated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active campground with tent sites, showers, laundry, on-site restaurant, and propane on a major cycling corridor (Alaska Highway); a clear practical benefit for touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: The electric car charger station listed on the website could potentially support e-bike charging, but this is not explicitly confirmed for cyclists and was therefore marked null. Hard and soft ice cream are sold on-site but bagged/block ice is not explicitly mentioned.

wow_evidence: tent sites, 24-hour coin-operated laundry and shower facilities, an on-site family restaurant, propane sales
